Her phone is off — but the telecom team confirmed her **smartwatch** has its own eSIM, and it never stopped talking to towers.
`tower_pings`: every time a phone or watch talks to a tower, a row is saved — owner, device, tower, area, time.

SELECT c1, COUNT(*) FROM table_name GROUP BY c1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;
